main_text.p: Errata reliqua benevolus Lector, præsertim in vocibus quæ accentibus intempestivè notatæ sunt, facilè condonabit.

page.notes: The first line's "Pag." is partly cut off at the left edge; the reading "Pag.[?]" is uncertain. The Greek words on the first line (ὁμοιοφυῶν) and on p. 231 (παρεμμένα) are hard to read at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The word "halitu" and "temporibus" are copied as printed. The "l." abbreviations and italic/roman distinctions in the list are not reliably visible, so no italics were added. The long s is written as a plain s throughout.
